fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Dade County and Miami politics, criticizing legislative representatives and discussing upcoming city commissioner elections and the selection of a new city manager. Coverage includes debate over a proposed racing bill, discussion of welfare funding and claims of local starvation, and Miami Beach political matters including recall talk. Articles and letters address public utilities (lack of gas mains in Shenandoah), transportation changes (Miami Beach jitney route change; causeway/bathing suit ordinance), civic organizations (American Legion relief and fundraising), prohibition enforcement and alleged local liquor production, and economic conditions such as the large-scale shipment of used cars out of South Florida. Also includes local features/columns ("Little Geraldine"), aviation satire, and a boxing match announcement (Young Manuel vs. Dandy Dorland).
